brand: Bhugtan Sahayak · open source (MIT) · Design Master Solutions LLC

scenes.title: The payment was approved. It never came.
lines: PM-KISAN, pension, MGNREGA wages,
scholarship, subsidy:
why did it not reach my account?
Bhugtan Sahayak finds the likely reason,
the official check and the fix.
scenes.say: A government payment was approved, but it never reached the account. Bhugtan Sahayak finds the most likely reason, the official way to check it, and the fix, in English and Hindi.

scenes.title: Six taps, no personal data
lines: Which payment, what happened, when it last came,
any bank change, and for PM-KISAN:
e-KYC and land records.
It never asks for Aadhaar,
a bank account or a phone number.
scenes.say: Up to six taps: which payment, what happened, when it last came, and whether a bank account was opened, closed or blocked. It never asks for Aadhaar, an account number or a phone number.

scenes.title: Reasons from the official rules
lines: Money goes to the account seeded last
in the NPCI mapper (NPCI APB SOP).
Each reason: the official check,
the exact path and what that site asks for.
scenes.say: Here the money went to another account. Aadhaar payments go to the account seeded last in the NPCI mapper, so the first check is the bank seeding status on myAadhaar or NPCI BASE, with the exact path.

scenes.title: A letter to show at the counter
lines: Hindi or English, blanks filled by hand.
Copy, WhatsApp, or read aloud.
Inoperative account? It cites the RBI
circular of 1 January 2024: no charge.
scenes.say: Then a short request to show at the bank, in Hindi or English, with blank lines filled by hand. It can be copied, sent on WhatsApp, or read aloud. It never promises that money will come.

scenes.title: Works on a cheap phone
lines: Under 100 KB, no install, no account.
27 tests on the rules and the page,
each one seen failing on a broken rule.
scenes.say: It works on a cheap phone, with no install and no account. Twenty seven tests guard the rules, and each one was seen failing on a broken rule.

scenes.title: Impact, counted in public
lines: bhugtan-sahayak.designmaster.workers.dev/stats
Diagnoses, letters copied or shared,
and "Did it work?" answers.
No personal data.
scenes.say: Every diagnosis, every letter shared and every did it work answer is counted in public, without personal data. Bhugtan Sahayak, free and open source.
